chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Sallam al-Nakhkhas, from some of our companions, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

We are al-Mathani which God gave to our Prophet Muhammad (may God's blessings be upon him and his family). We are the Face of God, moving about on earth among you. We are the Eye of God among His creation, and His Hand extended with mercy upon His servants. Whoever recognized us, recognized us; and whoever was ignorant of us, was ignorant of us — and (we are) the Imams of the pious.

key_terms.إِمَامَةَ الْمُتَّقِينَ: Imams of the pious — the Imams are the legitimate leaders of all who are God-conscious
key_terms.الْمَثَانِي: Al-Mathani — literally 'the doubled/repeated ones'; in Quranic usage (15:87) refers to al-Fatiha or verses repeated in prayer; here applied to the Imams as a gift of divine guidance given to the Prophet
key_terms.عَيْنُ اللَّهِ: Eye of God — metaphor of divine oversight and witness exercised through the Imams among creation
key_terms.وَجْهُ اللَّهِ: Face of God — a theological metaphor expressing that the Imams are the manifestation and intermediary of divine presence in the world
key_terms.يَدُهُ الْمَبْسُوطَةُ: His Extended Hand — divine mercy and blessing flowing to creation through the mediation of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about the Imams being the Face, Eye, and Hand of God?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) makes a profound theological declaration about the metaphysical station of the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt. He identifies them as al-Mathani — the 'oft-repeated' or 'doubled' gift given to Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), referencing Quran 15:87 — and as the Face, Eye, and Extended Hand of God among creation. The hadith closes with a chiasmic formula emphasizing that recognition of the Imams equals recognition of God, and that leadership of the pious belongs to them. This teaching was addressed to Shia companions in the context of establishing the theological necessity and cosmic status of the Imamate.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Sallam Al Nakhhas, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘We<sup>asws</sup> are ‘الْمَثَانِي’ the double which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Gave to our Prophet Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Face of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. We<sup>azwj</sup> turn over between you apparently, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the Eye of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> among His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and His<sup>azwj</sup> Hand Extended with the Mercy upon His<sup>azwj</sup> servants. The one who recognised us<sup>asws</sup>, recognised us<sup>asws</sup>, and the one who is ignorant of us<sup>asws</sup> is ignorant of us<sup>asws</sup>, and (we<sup>asws</sup> are) the Imams<sup>asws</sup> of the pious’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from abu Salam al-Khannas from some of our people from Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“We (family of Prophet Muhammad) are the al-Mathani (one of two) that Allah gave to Prophet Muhammad (s.a.). We are the Wajhullah (face of Allah, meaning a certain aspect of Allah’s relation with people) that move among you on earth. We are the eyes of Allah (overseers or observers from the side of Allah) in His creatures. We are the hands of Allah that are open with blessings for His servants. Those who wanted to know us have known us. There are people who are ignorant about us they are ignorant of us and of the leadership of the pious people.”
